description: Look up OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, xAI, Cohere, DeepSeek and Groq model IDs (and Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI and Azure) and return, for each one, its retirement status, retirement date, days left and replacement. Use it before writing, changing or keeping a model ID in code, or when the user asks whether a model still works. To find the IDs inside a codebase use scan_project instead; to list everything retiring soon use upcoming_retirements. Read-only. Data comes from the providers' official deprecation pages, re-checked daily at aidriftline.com (fetched with a 4 s timeout, falling back to the copy in the package when offline). IDs not in the registry return status "unknown": no retirement is published for them, which does not prove the ID exists. Up to 100 IDs per call; extra IDs are ignored.

ids.description: Model IDs exactly as written in code, e.g. ["gpt-4o", "claude-sonnet-4-5", "models/gemini-2.5-pro"]. Provider prefixes (openai/, models/), Bedrock, Vertex and OpenRouter spellings and Claude short names are accepted and normalized.

name: check_models

advice.description: One plain sentence to pass on to the user

days_left.description: Days until the date; 0 or negative when it has passed

migration.description: Whether moving to the replacement is just a new model name (drop_in true) or needs more: change = rename | settings | params | api | re-embed | choose, with a note and the provider's guide

normalized.description: The ID after removing provider prefixes such as models/ or openai/

note.description: A fact from the provider's page beyond date and replacement, e.g. access already limited to existing users, or routed calls billed at the replacement's rates

page.description: aidriftline.com page with the source for this date

previous_replacement.description: The replacement the provider recommended before it changed its advice

qualifier.description: exact date, earliest possible shutdown (Google), or not before this date (Anthropic)

replacement_alt.description: A second replacement the provider names ("X or Y"); which one fits depends on how the model is used

replacement_changed.description: YYYY-MM-DD: when the change was seen on the provider's page

replacement_note.description: Extra instruction the provider gives with the replacement (e.g. a setting or API to use). Without it, switching the model name alone is not enough

routes.description: true: after the date the provider answers with the replacement model instead of failing

status.description: retired = calls fail (or are re-routed) now; at-risk = retires within 90 days; deprecated = retirement announced, further out; active = announced as active; unknown = no retirement published

under_review.description: Present when the provider's page no longer matches this entry and Driftline is updating it: since (date), what (date, replacement or listing), page (source to check)

next_step.description: Present when a model has to move: how to test prompts on the replacement first

registry_checked.description: Date the registry was last checked against the provider pages

registry_source.description: live = aidriftline.com/models.json; bundled = the copy shipped in the package (used offline)

title: Check model IDs for retirement
